caption: Issue #1097: F5 cycles a slow-motion tick-speed mode (100% -> 50% -> 25% -> 10%, Shift+F5 reverses). Engine.time_scale scales the delta each physics tick receives rather than skipping ticks, so it's a genuine slow-down of the same simulation, not a separate playback path -- watch the marching unit visibly cover less ground per stretch of the clip as each preset is pressed, while the persistent "N% SPEED" indicator (top-center) tracks the current setting.
